evidence.reason: The race was addressed by a later commit that rejects unit-switch records when the recorded snapshot identity disagrees with the source the switch was composed from. That is the missing under-lock identity check the finding requests, so the current HEAD/recovery mismatch no longer follows from the shown call ordering.
